name: aibackman
description: Unified AI conversation archive and backup manager

scripts.electron:dev: concurrently "npm run dev" "wait-on http://localhost:5173 && NODE_ENV=development electron ."
scripts.electron:dev:oom: concurrently "npm run dev" "wait-on http://localhost:5173 && AIBACKMAN_OOM_DEBUG=1 AIBACKMAN_BRIDGE_VISIBLE=1 NODE_ENV=development electron ."
scripts.electron:dev:oom:tracegc: concurrently "npm run dev" "wait-on http://localhost:5173 && AIBACKMAN_OOM_DEBUG=1 AIBACKMAN_TRACE_GC=1 AIBACKMAN_BRIDGE_VISIBLE=1 NODE_ENV=development electron ."
scripts.electron:release:debug: npm run build:debug && AIBACKMAN_DEBUG=1 AIBACKMAN_BRIDGE_VISIBLE=1 ELECTRON_ENABLE_LOGGING=1 ELECTRON_ENABLE_STACK_DUMPING=1 NODE_ENV=production electron --inspect=9229 .
